description: This file contains unit tests for the ModifyAclSubstitutionStrategy class, focusing on its behavior in handling ACL commands with placeholders.

classes.name: ModifyAclSubstitutionStrategyTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the behavior of ModifyAclSubstitutionStrategy, particularly in relation to placeholder replacement within ACL modification commands.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Asserts that instances of ModifyAclSubstitutionStrategy are immutable.

methods.name: applyReturnsTheSameCommandInstanceWhenNoPlaceholderIsSpecified
methods.description: Tests that applying the substitution strategy on a command without placeholders returns the same command instance.

methods.name: applyReturnsTheReplacedCommandInstanceWhenPlaceholderIsSpecified
methods.description: Tests that applying the substitution strategy on a command with placeholders results in a command with placeholders replaced.
